notes: Profile: mid-size defense contractor building a classified document search offering for multiple DoD customers.
Primary need: on-prem / air-gapped RAG + scale embeddings + reranking for archival search across classified corpora.
Scale: initial index target ~18M documents (~8-15TB raw text). Long-term growth expected to 50M+. Want rolling reindex plan.
Performance targets: peak 120-200 QPS (concurrent user queries), P95 end-to-end query latency <200ms for vector + rerank (soft), goal <150ms with caching.
Cost sensitivity: procurement asks for cost-per-query modeling. Internal target $0.005-0.02/query depending on rerank depth (topK 50 -> 5).
Model preferences: vendor-verified open models, ability to pin to quantized variants. Prefer 768-1024 dim embeddings with batching.
Retrieval architecture: candidate recall layer (approx NN) + lightweight reranker (FFN/attn) to improve precision on short queries. Need support for custom rerank ops locally.
Security & compliance: air-gapped deployment mandatory for classified sets; FedRAMP + CMMC L3 posture expected by procurement; SOC2 and ISO27001 helpful.
Key constraints: customer-managed KMS, full audit trails (per-request), retention controls, strict network egress deny by default, no external telemetry for air-gapped instance.
Quote from CISO: 'We will not permit outbound telemetry; any non-essential data plane must be removable and auditable.'
Procurement notes: expecting 3-4 vendor finalists. Decision committee includes IT lead, CISO, program manager, contracts officer. Procurement timeline Q2 2026.
Technical ask: on-site appliance option or validated AMI for air-gapped datacenter; documentation for installation, hardening guides, STIG/CIS mappings.
POC scope requested: ingest 5M docs, create embedding index, run 10k legacy queries, show rerank uplift metric, produce latency/cost dashboard and SLO test report.
Current stance: favorable to Redwood if private offering confirms no external dependencies and we provide a FedRAMP gap remediation plan and fixed-price POC.
Logistics: vendor onboarding requires completed security questionnaire (sent 2026-02-20), IP & data handling clauses negotiated with contracts team.
Notes on integration: they use Splunk for logs, GitLab CI, and have an existing auth SAML IdP (Okta). Expect integration with internal SIEM and SIEM playbooks for alerts.
Remediation items: encryption-at-rest proof, HSM/KMS integration demo, offline install verification, deterministic index snapshot/export for audits.
Internal AE reminder: prepare procurement pack (SOW template, pricing scenarios, technical appendix) and route to solutions engineering for air-gapped checklist.
Buyer signals: asked about volume discounts, reserved capacity model for dedicated pools, and annual support SLAs (4hr P1 on-call).
